read-ai-vs-otter-ai.0: Read AI vs Otter AI is a common shortlist, and from a distance it is easy to see why. Both join Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Both write summaries and action items. Both have free plans.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.1: Up close? Different problems. Otter is built around the transcript: you read along live and search it later. Read AI is built around the meeting itself, which means it cares about how the call went, who spoke and for how long, how engaged people were, and what you could do better next time.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.3: Ask yourself what you want to know once the call ends. If it is "what exactly did they say?", Otter answers faster. If it is "how did that meeting go, and how do I run the next one better?", Read AI does.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.4: Otter AI is better for people who need accurate live notes, captions during calls, and the lowest price. Managers and sellers who want feedback on their meetings, plus reports they can share with a team, will get more from Read AI. Neither wins everything.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.6: On both billing cycles, Otter costs less. Otter Pro costs $16.99 monthly or $8.33 billed yearly, while Read AI Pro costs $19.75 monthly or $15 billed yearly. Team plans follow the same pattern. Otter Business is $19.99 billed yearly; Read AI Enterprise is $22.50 billed yearly and needs at least a 5-license minimum before you can buy it.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.9: Read AI has a similar jump. Its Enterprise tier, the one you need for audio and video playback, costs $22.50 to $29.75 per user and requires 5 licenses. So in both cases the real cost only shows up when a team outgrows the entry plan.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.11: Say you run a single weekly hour-long client call. Read AI Free covers it fully. Otter Free would cut each call in half.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.13: In-person meetings work too, since both mobile apps can record a conversation in the room. One catch with Otter: those in-person recordings count against the same 300 or 1,200 monthly minutes as your calls.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.15: Accuracy also depends on what you read. Otter shows the raw transcript, so errors are visible and easy to fix. Read AI leads with summaries, which means a misheard word may be smoothed over while a wrong number quietly slips into the report that goes to your manager. Check names, dates and prices before you share either output.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.17: For product teams, Read AI's Jira and Confluence connections give it a slight edge. Large sales teams may lean the other way, because Otter's Enterprise plan adds custom CRM and dialer integrations and an Otter Sales Notetaker.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.18: Security? Both offer enterprise tiers. Otter Enterprise includes SSO, SCIM, domain capture and a HIPAA compliance add-on. Read AI Enterprise+ includes HIPAA compliance, SAML, SCIM, domain capture and custom data retention.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.20: Fireflies sits between them. It records like Otter, then adds CRM sync and search across calls, at $10 per seat billed yearly for Pro. For Read AI vs Otter AI vs Fireflies, the short version is simple: pick Otter for transcripts, Read AI for analytics, and Fireflies for CRM-heavy sales.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.22: Yes. Lynkk (our product) focuses on what happens around the meeting rather than only the transcript or the analytics. You can let its bot join Zoom, Google Meet and Teams, or record without a bot through the Mac app and Chrome extension, which also covers in-person conversations.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.25: Pick Otter if you want live transcripts, captions and the lowest price per user. Want meeting analytics, coaching and native apps on Windows, Mac, Android and iOS? That is Read AI. And if what you need is prep before calls and tasks and Jira tickets after them, pick Lynkk.
